reading.title: Reading Comprehension · 阅读理解
reading.instruction: Read Dawen and Mom’s dialogue from workbook page 60 and answer the questions.
passage: 妈妈：大文，今天午餐想吃什么？
mā ma, dà wén, jīn tiān wǔ cān xiǎng chī shén me?
Mom: Dawen, what do you want for lunch today?
大文：我想吃汉堡跟薯条。我们可不可以出去吃？
dà wén, wǒ xiǎng chī hàn bǎo gēn shǔ tiáo. wǒ men kě bù kě yǐ chū qù chī?
Dawen: I want a hamburger and fries. Can we eat out?
妈妈：今天先在家吃，周末再出去吃吧。
mā ma, jīn tiān xiān zài jiā chī, zhōu mò zài chū qù chī ba.
Mom: Let us eat at home first, then go out to eat on the weekend.
大文：吃午餐以后，我可不可以吃冰淇淋？
dà wén, chī wǔ cān yǐ hòu, wǒ kě bù kě yǐ chī bīng qí lín?
Dawen: Can I have ice cream after lunch?
妈妈：可以，先吃饭，再吃冰淇淋。
mā ma, kě yǐ, xiān chī fàn, zài chī bīng qí lín.
Mom: Yes. Eat your meal first, then eat ice cream.

prompt: dà wén wǔ cān xiǎng chī shén me?

options: dàn chǎo fàn gēn shuǐ guǒ
dàn chǎo fàn gēn yù mǐ tāng
egg fried rice and corn soup

prompt: shén me shí hòu kě yǐ chū qù chī?
